Published rational concentration in odd degrees 7 and15 identifies genuine combined homology character. Walsh transform of all 64 translations yields nonnegative integer multiplicities 36,1,0,6,6,0,1 (total dimension 253), verified from packaged checker. Dependency on published 2026 large Betti-rank computation is disclosed, not falsely recertified.

value.rationale: The six-cube at scale four is the first nontrivial interior Rips parameter not covered by previous representation theorems. The exact translation module answers a natural, explicit published symmetry-action question in this case and yields new structural constraints: a 36-dimensional invariant subspace and absent dual-weight-two/five characters. These are not consequences of the previously known total Betti dimension and Euler count and can constrain construction of equivariant generators.
